title: AnomalyModel
description: Model slot, catalog row anomaly-model 1.0.0: the inference contract of the denoising autoencoder that scores how far an operating result lies from the engine's training manifold, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/stages/train.py to data/derived/models/psd-ae.json beside the ONNX graph data/derived/models/psd-ae.onnx. The input is the 14 features of feature_order built from an engine result (log10 of p80_mm, p50_mm and p20_mm, the five product fractions passing, throughput_tph, power_kw, reduction_ratio, log10 of f80_mm, specific_energy_kwh_t, feed_m) standardised as (value - mean) / std; the graph's input x has shape [1, 14] and its output xr the reconstruction of the same shape. The score is the mean squared reconstruction error over the 14 values; a score above threshold_p99 (the 99th percentile of the scores on the training draw) marks the point anomalous. The slot's baseline is the engine's envelope gate (pipeline.model.crusher.envelope): a rule check that flags a point outside the physical and calibrated envelope. Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: mean and std have the length of feature_order, every std is positive, and the ONNX file exists with the sha256 given.

architecture.description: The layer sizes, for example 14-16-6-16-14, and the input noise used in training.

export_parity_max_abs.description: The maximum absolute difference between the trained torch module's reconstruction and the exported graph's (run through onnxruntime) on the held-out draw, in standardised features, measured by train.py right after export; evidence the export preserved the trained module.
